classification: Try at most two common anchors ranked by exact mean-separation squared over variance bound; threshold floor of midpoint of mean-interval centers. Full overlap range covered by 64 closed rational slices. First TV>1/4 exclusion or HOLD.
stop: Exactly one pass over the 38 inherited cells. No subdivision, overlap refinement, added anchors or retuned thresholds.
freeze_note: Internal freeze before first new event evaluation. Prior PR114 results and geometry-only statistics are known; not external preregistration.
